_analyticsComment: Plausible, added 2026-08-24, real site created 2026-08-27. Cookieless, so no consent banner and nothing to opt into; disclosed in /privacy. NOTE: this is Plausible's NEWER script format — the site id is baked into the FILENAME (pa-<id>.js) and there is no data-domain attribute; it must be paired with the inline plausible.init() stub, which each renderer emits. `domain` below is kept for humans only, the script no longer reads it. File-download and outbound-link tracking are NO LONGER selected via the script filename (the old script.file-downloads.outbound-links.js) — they are toggled per-site in the Plausible dashboard. Read by all THREE renderers: Layout.astro, tools/sync-chrome.mjs, and tools/gen_site.py in the monorepo. Set enabled=false to pull it from all three at once.
